recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the explicit FHIR-39141 cardinality requirement and aligns Transport.reason with Event.reason without reintroducing removed elements.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive-with-Modification OO issue asking to replace Transport.reasonCode and Transport.reasonReference with a single Transport.reason CodeableReference at cardinality 0..*.
initial_application: Commit 69b0fca978 removed the old reasonCode/reasonReference material and introduced Transport.reason CodeableReference, but retained max 1 from the prior element.
additional_context: Transport is active in fhir.ini. Current Transport is Event-aligned, Event.reason is repeatable, and the mapping exception explicitly recorded Event.reason * versus Transport.reason 1. Searches found no later final decision preserving max 1.
reconciliation: Changed Transport.reason max from 1 to * and removed the obsolete upper-cardinality exception from the Transport/Event mapping exception file.
source_changes: source/transport/transport-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: removed the obsolete Event.reason upper-cardinality mismatch entry.

related_jiras.note: Later Transport.reason issue confirming no rename was needed because reasonCode was gone and TransportReason needed an example ValueSet.
Removed remaining request-oriented Transport elements and left Transport as an event resource, supporting Event.reason alignment.
Related Transport ValueSet audit already represented on the combined branch and not re-decided here.
